# Flowable Engine License Provenance & Compliance Evidence

Project: Flowable Engine (flowable-engine / flowable-rest)
Component Family: BPMN 2.0 / CMMN 1.1 / DMN 1.3 Workflow Runtime
Verified License Identifier: Apache-2.0 (Apache License, Version 2.0)
Verification Date: 2026-10-02
Compliance Disposition: ACCEPTABLE (Permissive open source; approved for Phase-3 Workflow Runtime adoption)

## Verified Upstream Source

1. Flowable Open Source Workflow Engine
   - Package / Image: flowable/flowable-rest:7.0.0
   - Official Upstream Repository: https://github.com/flowable/flowable-engine
   - Official LICENSE Location: https://github.com/flowable/flowable-engine/blob/main/LICENSE
   - Official NOTICE Location: https://github.com/flowable/flowable-engine/blob/main/NOTICE
   - License: Apache-2.0
   - Phase-3 Role: Standalone workflow runtime and human task lifecycle engine executed via REST API boundary. Executes BPMN 2.0 process graphs, timer countdowns, and sequence flows.

## Architectural Boundaries & Isolation
- Deployed exclusively as a decoupled, isolated container service (`flowable/flowable-rest:7.0.0`).
- Dedicated PostgreSQL database (`flowable_db`) completely segregated from E-7 canonical persistence (`operations_engine`).
- E-7 Alembic does NOT manage Flowable Liquibase `ACT_*` tables.
- All interactions flow through provider-neutral `WorkflowAdapterProtocol` and `FlowableAdapter`.
- Flowable native execution IDs are strictly secondary external references; public E-7 API contracts expose only canonical E-7 identifiers.
- Zero copying of Flowable Java source code into IR application core.

## Attribution & Usage Policy
- Operate unmodified binary container image (`flowable/flowable-rest:7.0.0`).
- Retain standard Apache-2.0 copyright and NOTICE files in external distribution manifests.
- Multi-tenant data isolation and authorization enforced on the E-7 API boundary prior to reaching Flowable.
